description: Plataforma de movilidad tipo InDrive — monorepo Expo + Firebase

scripts.android:clean: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for(const g of ['apps/app-pasajero/android/gradlew.bat','apps/app-conductor/android/gradlew.bat']){const full=path.resolve(g);if(fs.existsSync(full)){try{cp.execSync('\"'+full+'\" --stop',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch{}}}if(fs.existsSync('node_modules')){for(const e of fs.readdirSync('node_modules')){const p=e.startsWith('@')?fs.readdirSync(path.join('node_modules',e)).map(s=>path.join('node_modules',e,s)):[path.join('node_modules',e)];for(const pkg of p){const b=path.join(pkg,'android','build');if(fs.existsSync(b)){fs.rmSync(b,{recursive:true,force:true})}}}}"
